verdict.rationale: ByteAsk's own /agents command center groups multiple agent sessions by state (needs-input, working, ready, finished), which implies several sessions can run concurrently. `byteask queue` can also message a running session from another terminal. However, `exec` runs a single task to completion, approval prompts are the default, and nothing documents launching fleets or long autonomous runs. Missing for 10: documented fleet or batch launching of parallel agents, evidence of multi-hour or multi-day autonomous runs, documented concurrency limits or orchestration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can launch fleets of autonomous agents that work in parallel on different tasks for hours or days

citations.quote: /agents opens a command center grouping your agent sessions into needs-input, working, ready and finished.
byteask queue --thread <session> --message "…" sends a message into a running session from another terminal.
